Definition: a puzzle, hence, a trick, conundrum, sententious maxim
BiblicalUsage: 1) riddle, difficult question, parable, enigmatic saying or question, perplexing saying or question; 1a) riddle (dark obscure utterance); 1b) riddle, enigma (to be guessed); 1c) perplexing questions (difficult); 1d) double dealing (with 'havin')
